answer.reason: Genesis 38 tells what Onan did and how he died, beyond the bare relations in the summary.

clauses.english: refused to raise up seed to his brother and spilled it on the ground when he went in to his brother's wife
clauses.quote: he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother

doubts: The summary already says he was killed by the LORD, so the death is left out of the clauses; GEN 38:10 gives the reason it was done (the thing displeased the LORD).
